name: Story reward: Pirate World conclusion
comment: Script 1066 (XX_Story Quest Reward ... Conclusion 462486). A world's last story step: a Member Super Chest and the bag of the minifigure its last story dungeon, 4310 Pirate Grotto (Captain Dreadleg), shows as the reward in its teleport window (RDB 1000644, as pocket adventures' world `minifigure`) (the user's rule 2026-10-29: 'a Member Super Chest + the minifigure associated with that dungeon's reward'; which dungeon concludes the world and that the minifigure comes as a bag are guesses, docs/TUNABLES.md).
